text.body: maheśvara uvāca | śrījaganmaṅgalasyāsya kavacasya prajāpatiḥ ||1|| ṛṣiścando'sya gāyatrī devī rāseśvarī svayam | śrīkṛṣṇabhaktisamprāptau viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||2|| śiṣyāya kṛṣṇabhaktāya brahmaṇāya prakāśyet | śaṭhāya paraśiṣyāya dattvā mṛtyumavāpnuyāt ||3|| rājyaṃ deyaṃ śiro deyaṃ na deyaṃ kavacaṃ priye | kaṇṭhe dhṛtamidaṃ bhaktyā kṛṣṇena paramātmanā ||4|| mayā dṛṣṭaṃ ca goloke brahmaṇā viṣṇunā purā | oṃ rādheti caturthyantaṃ vahnijāyāntameva ca ||5|| kṛṣṇenopāsito mantraḥ kalpavṛkṣaḥ śiro'vatu | oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ rādhikāṅentaṃ vahnijāyāntameva ca ||6|| kapālaṃ netrayugmaṃ ca śrotrayugmaṃ sadāvatu | oṃ rāṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ rādhiketi ṅentaṃ vahni jāyāntameva ca ||7|| mastakaṃ keśasaṃghāṃśca mantrarājaḥ sadāvatu | oṃ rāṃ rādheti caturthyantaṃ vahnijāyāntameva ca ||8|| sarvasiddhipradaḥ pātu kapolaṃ nāsikāṃ mukham | klīṃ śrīṃ kṛṣṇapriyāṅentaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ pātu namo'ntakam ||9|| oṃ rāṃ rāseśvarīṅentaṃ skandhaṃ pātu namo'ntakam | oṃ rāṃ rāsavilāsinyai svāhā pṛṣṭhaṃ sadāvatu ||10|| vṛndāvanavilāsinyai svāhā vakṣaḥ sadāvatu | tulasīvanavāsinyai svāhā pātu nitambakam ||11|| kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikāṅentaṃ svāhāntaṃ praṇavādikam | pādayugmaṃ ca sarvāṅgaṃ saṃtataṃ pātu sarvataḥ ||12|| rādhā rakṣatu prācyāṃ ca vahnau kṛṣṇapriyāvatu | tulasīvanavāsinyai svāhā pātu nitambakam ||13|| paścime nirguṇā pātu vāyavye kṛṣṇapūjitā | uttare saṃtataṃ pātu mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ||14|| sarveśvarī sadaiśānyāṃ pātu māṃ sarvapūjitā | jale sthale cāntarikṣe svapne jāgaraṇe tathā ||15|| mahāviṣṇośca jananī sarvataḥ pātu saṃtataṃ | kavacaṃ kathitaṃ durge śrījaganmaṅgalaṃ param ||16|| yasmai kasmai na dātavya guḍhād guḍhataraṃ param | tava snehānmayākhyātaṃ pravaktaṃ na kasyacit ||17|| gurumabhyarcya vidhivad vastrālaṃkāracandanaiḥ | kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau dhṛtvā viṣṇosamo bhavet ||18|| śatalakṣajapenaiva siddhaṃ ca kavacaṃ bhavet | yadi syāt siddhakavaco na dagdho vahninā bhavet ||19|| etasmāt kavacād durge rājā duryodhanaḥ purā | viśārado jalastambhe vahnistambhe ca niścitam ||20|| mayā sanatkumārāya purā dattaṃ ca puṣkare | sūryaparvaṇi merau ca sa sāndīpanaye dadau ||21|| balāya tena dattaṃ ca dadau duryodhanāya saḥ | kavacasya prasādena jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ ||22|| nityaṃ paṭhati bhaktyedaṃ tanmantropāsakaśca yaḥ | viṣṇutulyo bhavennityaṃ rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ||23|| snānena sarvatīrthānāṃ sarvadānena yatphalam | sarvavratopavāse ca pṛthivyāśca pradakṣiṇe ||24|| sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣāyāṃ nityaṃ ca satyarakṣaṇe | nityaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasevāyāṃ kṛṣṇanaivedyabhakṣaṇe ||25|| pāṭhe caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ yatphalaṃ ca labhennaraḥ | yatphalaṃ labhate nūnaṃ paṭhanāt kavacasya ca ||26|| rājadvāre śmaśāne ca siṃhavyāghrānvite vane | dāvāgnau saṃkaṭe caiva dasyucaurānvite bhaye ||27|| kārāgāre vipadgraste ghore ca dṛḍhabandhane | vyādhiyukto bhavenmukto dhāraṇāt kavacasya ca ||28|| ityetatkathitaṃ durge tavaivedaṃ maheśvari | tvameva sarvarūpā māṃ māyā pṛcchasi māyayā ||29|| śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca | ityuktvā rādhikākhyānaṃ smāraṃ ca mādhavam | pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgaḥ sāśrunetro babhuva saḥ ||30|| na kṛṣṇasadṛśo devo na gaṅgāsadṛśī sarit | na puṣkarasamaṃ tīrthaṃ nāśrāmo brāhmaṇāt para ||31|| paramāṇuparaṃ sūkṣmaṃ mahāviṣṇoḥ paro mahān | nabha paraṃ ca vistīrṇaṃ yathā nāstyeva nārada ||32|| tathā na vaiṣṇavād jñānī yigīndraḥ śaṃkarāt paraḥ | kāmakrodhalobhamohā jitāstenaiva nārada ||33|| svapne jāgaraṇe śaśvat kṛṣṇadhyānarataḥ śivaḥ | yathā kṛṣṇastathā śambhurna bhedo mādhaveśayoḥ ||34|| yathā śambhurvaiṣṇaveṣu yathā deveṣu mādhavaḥ | tathedaṃ kavacaṃ vatsa kavaceṣu praśastakam ||35|| iti śrībrahmavaivarte śrīrādhikākavacaṃ sampūrnam |
